name: pi-snippet
description: Inline suggestion snippets for pi: the model's suggested replies become clickable chips in a web UI and in the terminal

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/extension/pi-snippet.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/extension/pi-snippet.js && esbuild src/extension/pi-snippet-tui.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/extension/pi-snippet-tui.js
